title: Case 023: Invoice for Accounting
initial_request: Could you send me the invoice for policy INS-023 for 1 June 2025 to 31 May 2026? I need it for my accounting records for 123 Elm Walk, Brackenford, ZZ3 5ZZ.
overview: Molly Burke asked her agent, Neil at Fernwick Insurance, for the invoice for policy INS-023. Neil did not have the document on file, so he requested it from Alderwick Mutual's billing team. The billing team issued and sent the invoice to Neil, who forwarded invoice.png to Molly. Molly confirmed that she received it.

next_action.summary: Request the invoice for INS-023 from Alderwick Mutual's billing team, then forward it to Molly.

outcome: Molly confirmed that she received the invoice; no payment confirmation is recorded.
